name: STIHL MS 194 C-E / MS 194 T
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ lightweight bars, 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links (63 PM3), per STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The MS 194 C-E and the top-handle MS 194 T are in one block of STIHL's 2025 chain chart, together with the MS 201 C-EM and MS 201 T C-M. The chart lists lightweight bars only: 12″ with 44 drive links, 14″ with 50 and 16″ with 55, all 63 PM3 (3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge). The MS 201 T C-M already has its own page from an earlier chart; this page is the 194, using the 2025 rows that name it.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 44 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7405. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 50 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7409. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.
STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 55 with lightweight bar 3005 000 7413. 3/8″ PICCO, .050″ gauge. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 4.0 mm (5/32″) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pages 166–167), including the file table and the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026. File size from that catalog's file table (4.0 mm / 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO).
